tlg_checks.sample: Ζεῦ, φύσεως ἀρχηγέ, νόμου μέτα πάντα κυβερνῶν (v.2)
πλὴν ὁπόσα ῥέζουσι κακοὶ σφετέραισιν ἀνοίαις (v.17)
κοινὸν ἀεὶ νόμον ἐν δίκῃ ὑμνεῖν (v.39)

edition_statement: Hans Friedrich August von Arnim (ed.), Stoicorum Veterum Fragmenta, vol. I: Zeno et Zenonis discipuli (Leipzig: Teubner, 1905) — Cleanthes, Testimonia et Fragmenta, fr. 537 (Stobaeus Ecl. I 1, 12 p. 25, 3 Wachsmuth); digitized by Open Greek and Latin / First1KGreek
issues: Hymn transmitted as single Stobaeus excerpt (1.1.12 = SVF I 537); segmented into 4 strophic units (vv. 1-6, 7-16, 17-31, 32-39) per Thom 2005 structure, loci appended to the fragment-level URN as :537:<vv-range> (sub-fragment loci are not independently resolvable CTS references)
Editorial supplements in angle brackets retained as printed by von Arnim: v.11 ⟨τελεῖται⟩, v.30 ⟨ἀλλὰ κακοῖς ἐπέκυρσαν⟩, v.33 ⟨μὲν⟩
TLG E text of v.4 differs (γενόμεσθα, θεοῦ μίμημα vs Arnim γένος εἴσʼ ἤχου μίμημα) — known textual crux, edition variance only; ingested text is byte-verbatim Arnim/First1KGreek
